suggestions: pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, MAX(ss_agg.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss, MAX(cs_agg.catalog_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_store_sk AS ss_store_sk, ss.ss_net_profit AS ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999
) AS ss_agg
JOIN store_returns sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss_agg.ss_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss_agg.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss_agg.ss_ticket_number
JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999
JOIN (
    SELECT cs.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, MAX(cs.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_profit
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY cs.cs_bill_customer_sk, cs.cs_item_sk
) AS cs_agg ON cs_agg.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND cs_agg.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss_agg.ss_store_sk
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss_agg.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
